items.quote: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.
items.claim: The breastplate was bound to the ephod using rings and a blue lace to prevent it from becoming detached, as the LORD commanded Moses.
items.mechanism: by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue
